summary: First test run of PackIntel (SIH260236). Backend pytest suite (28 tests) passes 100% against public URL. Frontend E2E via Playwright covers Home, Analysis (demo load, validation), Results (all required data-testids), Compare, Materials (search + drawer), Methodology, and mobile nav. All specified dynamic behaviours verified (respiration, frozen exclusion, sustainability, MAP toggle, low_cost=LDPE, chips=barrier/foil, rice=HDPE).
critical_code_review_comments: Materials/Commodities list endpoints return wrapped {materials:[...], count, data_source}. README example implies a plain list - consider documenting the wrapper shape or standardising response envelopes across list vs detail endpoints.

Recommendation payload uses 'material_name' (not 'name') on the MaterialOut object although the Pydantic schema declares MaterialOut (with .name in schemas). Ensure schema and serialiser are aligned to avoid surprise on API consumers.
Consider adding a rate limit / caching layer for /api/environment (Open-Meteo) to avoid outages when the external API throttles.
Health check reports PostgreSQL connected fine, but no readiness check for the seed data count is exposed - a lightweight /api/health?deep=true returning seeded counts would help ops.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing PostgreSQL seed (9 materials, 10 commodities).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend list endpoints return {materials:[...]} / {commodities:[...]} envelopes; recommendation MaterialOut uses 'material_name'. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_packintel_api.py works against public URL. Compare page requires prior recommendation result in sessionStorage - navigate via Results -> compare-materials-button to test.
